profile.headline: Computational Geometry Engineer, Retired
profile.summary: Extensive experience building, shipping and managing projects in the area of tooling for 3D geometry applications.  Have personally built and shipped applications individually or with very small teams.  Most recently authored an application for robot modeling and simulation.  Hands on experience in robotics, physics, Inverse Kinematics, computational geometry, and system architecture.   I have experience working in start-up environments, as well as cross team efforts in large organizations.  I have lead and managed teams of engineers and provided vision for agendas with strategic importance.  Have worked in advanced technology/research groups as well as product development teams.   I have personally developed geometry and animation and physics algorithms for use in products.  Self-directed, motivated, and highly productive.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Engineer
positions.description: Built an application for 3D modeling and simulation of manufacturing robots.  Personally responsible for all of the system architecture, geometry representations and manipulations, IK, animations, snapping, human interaction model, and more.
positions.insights: Skills: Inverse Kinematics · Robot simulation · Computational Geometry · Application Architecture · Project Management

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: I am in the VR division at Google, working on a web based authoring tool servicing an educational product.  My area of focus is introducing a 3D model authoring capability into the tool.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: A member of the technical staff of Google Spotlight Stories in the ATAP division.  Personally responsible for the design and implementation of StoryViewer, a key tool used for authoring content.   The product is also being used as a base for several other stand-alone editing tools.

positions.title: Sr. Engineering Manager
positions.description: I was responsible for the architecture and implementation of two key areas of the Ninja Authoring Tool, namely the 3D, and WebGL and canvas 2D based rendering capabilities. Ninja is an advanced HTML5 authoring tool intended for creative professionals that was developed while I was at Motorola Mobility. I also managed Ninja Advanced Technology Group, whose charter was to develop advanced geometry and rendering capabilities for Ninja. I was personally responsible for 4 patent submissions, and collaborated on an additional 4 submissions.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: A member of Adobe's Advanced technology group.  Developed advanced technologies in the areas of Inverse Kinematics and Rigid Body Physics and implemented them as features in the Flash Authoring tool.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer on Adobe's Acrobat 3D product.
